toes.name: word-count
toes.description: Counts the words on every page and adds a little status line.

toes.name: toe-scheme
toes.description: Registers the toe:// scheme. toe://hello says hi; toe://gallery lists every installed toe.

toes.name: sock-detective
toes.description: A hard-boiled private investigator for page guts. Toggle sniff mode with the button and hover, or open toe://sock for the full case file.

toes.name: toe-bar
toes.description: A wide, cluttered, early-2000s toolbar. Marquee, banner ads, popups, a hit counter, and a web ring. Best viewed in 800x600.

toes.name: dark-mode
toes.description: Skims every page with a dark theme. Your eyes will thank the toe.

toes.name: reader
toes.description: Strips a page down to its article text. Reading, without the clutter.

toes.name: session-keeper
toes.description: Remembers your open tabs. Restore them from session:// whenever you come back.

toes.name: toe-latin
toes.description: Renders every page in Pig Latin. Educational AND unhinged.

toes.name: keyboard-ninja
toes.description: Vim-style navigation: j/k to scroll, gg/G to jump. HANDS OFF THE MOUSE.
